approach.label: Our approach
approach.title: Three steps. Always in this order.
approach.intro: AskBodhi is an AI-first growth partner for Dutch SMEs. We combine SEO, GEO (findability in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews) and SEA with process optimisation. We start where results are measurable fastest, and only go a step further once that works.

steps.title: Stop the waste in search
steps.text: We map which traffic actually brings in revenue. Then we rebuild how Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity find you. Ads stay only where they pay for themselves.
steps.notice: Organic traffic growing again, less reliance on ads, and more enquiries from the right customers. First movement typically in month two.

steps.title: Hand over the repetitive work
steps.text: Once the foundation is in place, we build a digital colleague on your business. It drafts, watches your market and reports in plain language. Your team approves and stays in charge.
steps.notice: Marketing keeps moving when your team is busy. Without hiring.

steps.title: Cut what adds no value
steps.text: We walk through the rest of the business with you: quotes, customer questions, admin, hand-offs between people and systems. What adds no value disappears or goes to AI. What stays gets simpler.
steps.notice: Your people spend their time on customers and craft, not on retyping and chasing.

engine.label: The Bodhi Engine
engine.text: Not a chatbot and not a subscription to someone else's software. We build it on your data, teach it how your company communicates and hand you the keys. If we ever stop working together, it stays with you.

roles.title: It writes

roles.title: It keeps watch
roles.text: Your Google positions every week, whether ChatGPT and Perplexity name you or a competitor, and a plain-language summary once a month.

faq.label: Questions
faq.title: What business owners ask us first

items.a: AskBodhi is an AI-first growth partner for Dutch SMEs. We find where your company loses money and time and fix it in a fixed order: first findability in Google and AI assistants (SEO, GEO and SEA), then a digital colleague of your own for the repetitive work, then cutting work that adds no value.

items.q: What exactly do you mean by waste?
items.a: Anything you put money or time into that doesn't bring in customers or revenue. An ad budget doing the job of organic traffic that's missing or falling, visitors who never buy, and manual work a system or AI does better.

GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization: making sure AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews name your company when someone asks for advice. It builds on a sound SEO foundation, which is why we do the two together.

items.q: Isn't this just an SEO agency?
items.a: We start with findability because that's where results show fastest. But we don't stop there: next we take over the repetitive work, then we look at your processes.
We decide together when ads are worth it and plan them alongside organic. The goal is a lower ad bill, not a higher one.

items.q: We don't have a CTO or a marketing team. Is that a problem?
items.a: No, that's when we're most useful. We take on the growth and AI decisions that otherwise sit with nobody. As an external partner, not an interim hire.
You do. Your content, your data, your website and the engine we build on them. No licence that stops when we stop.
First measurable movement typically shows in month two. In month one we agree what we measure; in month three we decide together whether it's working.
